title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Any work today? If it's nothing urgent, let's put it off till later.

title: Talk 1
original: My Arts detect nearby creatures, and this auxiliary device even amplifies the ability. Sounds great, right? That's why the Garrison Team sent me to patrol the city, in case any students were trying to climb the walls and skip school. I gotta admit, they sure know how to put people to work.

title: Talk 2
original: Just for the record, the so-called secret of Laterano or whatever? I don't know a single thing about it. I'm just after the easy life. The less I know, the better off I'll be, don't you think?

title: Talk 3
original: Hmm? Isn't that guy over there from the Notarial Hall...? What? He wants to make sure I'm 'fulfilling my obligations?' Dear Lord! I pay my taxes on time every month, okay? Anyway, just give me a whisper if he's looking for me. I need time to run and hide.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: I was really bored, so I went down to the bridge to chill out… Err, I mean, I wanted to enjoy the scenery. But everybody was looking at me like I was there to assassinate somebody. Man, they really take me for a killer? As if I'd ever want a job like that. Way too much trouble.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: My old brass would always drone on about 'defending the glory of Laterano with your life' and blah blah blah. But that kind of stuff is so boring. I hated how dead-end my life was back then. Working with Rhodes Island is way better. You give me something more practical.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: My hair's a little messy? Meh, I forgot to deal with my bed head. It's not like I have a mission today... Aww, this sucks... Can you tell me if my braid is crooked? It feels kinda weird. You really oughta have a mirror in your office, you know.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Here, I got you a cake. So, what do you usually do during your breaks? You really should take a lap around the city, get yourself some fresh air, don't you think? If you're worried about your safety, just grab an operator who can go 'pow pow' on any baddies who pop up, and you're set.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Wanna watch a movie? We're almost done with work anyway. How about... this romance about a princess and a wanderer from afar? Wait, I need to hang up my do-not-disturb sign. Wouldn't want someone walking in with a pile of documents.

title: Idle
original: Break time. Now, what should I do...?

title: Onboard
original: Ambriel, sniper, from Laterano… Alright, that's introductions out of the way before they give me a headache. Here, I just opened this pack of chocolate pretzel sticks. Want one?

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Man, how long is this video…? Is there no option to play all of them at once?

title: Promotion 1
original: Much obliged. Oh, speaking of which, do these promotions come with a salary increase? There's something I've been looking at…

title: Promotion 2
original: Thank you very much. I've been with Rhodes Island for a while now, right? Before I knew it, I'd gotten a whole lot out of this, and made some good memories too.

title: Added to Squad
original: Woah, my teammates look pretty capable this time.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Just a heads-up for you, my tactics are a little unorthodox.

title: Depart
original: Ready? Let's get going.

title: Begin Operation
original: I hope we can wrap this mission up before dinner.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Hmm?

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Let me finish this choco stick first.

title: Deployment 1
original: Sniper platform, deploying~

title: Deployment 2
original: Auto-calibration in progress.

title: In Battle 1
original: There you are.

title: In Battle 2
original: Well, well, well, somebody's no good at hiding.

title: In Battle 3
original: Wide-open spaces are dangerous, y'know.

title: In Battle 4
original: I'll send you home.

title: 4-star Result
original: You always win big like this, Doctor. You're really something!

title: 3-star Result
original: Not a single shot wasted - perfect.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Not the prettiest victory, but a win's a win, right?

title: Operation Failure
original: The number of targets is still increasing, and they're about to launch an attack. Doctor, let's get out of here...

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Doctor! Time to restock the pretzel sticks in the vending machine!

title: Tap
original: What?

title: Trust Tap
original: I hear some new clothes came into the store? Doctor, come check 'em out with me!

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Huh? You're goofing off here too? Alright then, come take a seat. I feel kinda peaceful, sitting on the bridge, watching the busy people run all over the deck. But why is it so empty today? Kinda straaange... Wait a second! Today is New Year's?!

title: Greeting
original: Yo.

title: Birthday
original: Happy birthday, got this for you. 'Cheez-Pack'd Butter Flavor Cheese Snaps.' It's a limited-edition, definitely not my extras—okay, I admit it. I bought a little too much. Soooo my savings are dry. Anyway, why don't we hit the streets together next time? I'll make it up to you with something good when we do.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: You want to know what I've found at Rhodes Island that's so 'practical'? Um, obviously, seeing a different sunset on the bridge every day, and the feeling of using this gun to do something good. Pretty cool, yeah? Just kidding. Alright, let's forget all this complicated stuff. I'm gonna nab some pudding from the canteen!
